prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Confirm Pet Identity & Issue Certificate", "Name Your New Companion", "Give your desktop pet a name and style.", "Pet Name", "Choose Collar Accent"]
1: ["Your Pet is Arriving Soon!", "Pet Habitat Preview", "Feed Virtual Snack"]
2: ["Your Companion is Ready!", "Desktop Companion Controls Cheat Sheet", "Learn how to interact with and control your pet on your desktop.", "Right-click pet for actions menu", "Drag and drop to reposition on screen"]
3: []
4: ["Save Your Companion Profile", "Signing in secures your unique pet configuration and auto-syncs across reinstalls."]
5: ["Generating sprite animations", "Initializing desktop behaviors"]
6: ["Choose How You Want to Meet Your Companion"]
7: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Founders Edition Pet Badge"]
8: ["If your desktop pet hides, double-click the tray icon near your taskbar clock."]
9: ["Your companion lives directly on your desktop and reacts to your workflow.", "Desktop companion overview"]

verdicts.problem: Suggests scarcity or exclusive membership tier by referencing a Founders Edition badge.
